scientific_integrity: An exact proof via a primitive affine normal and lattice-index identity; finite integer computations are reproducibility checks and do not establish the infinite-family theorem.
scientific_limitations: One exceptional positive integer weight in otherwise constant-weight naturally oriented cycle; normalized volume refers to the changing intrinsic affine lattice. The theorem does not determine the nonunimodular IDP classification or general heterogeneous-weight cycles. Historical priority has not been independently determined.
title: Divisor-stratified lattice volumes of one-defect directed-cycle simplices
